chat.title: Chat
chat.placeholder: Describe a requirement here; it becomes a proposed story change that you approve.

chat.approvedPosthoc: Approved. The change was already in git.
chat.rejected: Rejected. Nothing was changed in git.

chat.unreviewedTitle: {count, plural, one {# unreviewed change} other {# unreviewed changes}}

chat.truncated: The last test result was too large and was cut off, so no story can be green from it.
chat.decidedTitle: {count, plural, one {# decided card} other {# decided cards}}
chat.needsRevert: Rejected: going live in the domain or the company waits for a commit that reverts this change.
chat.storylessOffer: Create or update a story from this change
